title: Row count
statement: For an almost $k$-wise input, let $d$ be the field degree associated with its Vandermonde input. Define the row count to be $(k-1)d+1$.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the bias numerator is at most the denominator
caveat: The supplied statement uses the field degree of the Vandermonde input, but does not include the definition of that field degree.
